decisions.quote: Results in first row exactly or closely match those in HP19 Table 3, panel A, column 1; Table 5, panel A, columns 1 and 2; and Table 6, first panel, column 1.
decisions.reason: Re-running the original specifications on the original data reproduces the reported baseline employment estimates in the first rows of Tables 3–6, whereas the sample exclusions, geocoding revisions, and alternative treatment radii tested in subsequent rows are specification and data revisions captured under robustness challenges.
